title: The Sabbath Question About Plucking Grain
description: The disciples pluck grain on the Sabbath as they walk through the fields, leading the Pharisees to accuse them of breaking the Sabbath law. Jesus defends them by pointing out how David ate the showbread when he was in need, and declares that the Sabbath was made for man's sake, not the other way around—and that the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.
